name: adecco-tenant-admin-mohr
description: Resolved preset of impersonate-tenant: host admin -> impersonate Admin Mohr into Defence Force Recruiting (tenancy 'adecco', Tenant type), lands on the Tenant portal landing page

params.tenantMatch: Row with Tenant name/Trading name 'Defence Force Recruiting', Tenancy name 'adecco', Code 'DFR', Type 'Tenant' (there is also a 'DNU - Test Only' row under the same 'Defence Force Recruiting' tenant name with tenancy 'defenceforcerecruiting' -- that one is NOT this tenant, disambiguate by tenancy name 'adecco')

steps.expect: Tenants list visible; runs login.json first if not authenticated

steps.target: Tenant name / tenancy code search input
steps.expect: filtered list shows the 'Defence Force Recruiting' / adecco row

steps.target: Login button in the row with Tenancy name 'adecco' (Defence Force Recruiting, Tenant type, ~19 users, ~7127 bookings)
Impersonate button in the row for 'Admin Mohr (management@myocchealthrecord.com)'
steps.expect: redirect to {tenant}/?impersonationToken=...&tenantId=... then to {tenant}/#/app/landing, 'Hi, Admin!' module tile grid visible

verifiedSessionCookies.note: document.cookie should contain MOHR.TenantId.localhost and MOHR.AuthToken.localhost. Decode the JWT to sanity check.

gotchas: If the redirect lands on a blank page and network shows net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED on the tenant port, the tenant dev server (yarn tenant:serve, port 4201) simply isn't running yet -- this is NOT a code regression. Ask the user to start/confirm it (`curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:4201` returning 200 confirms it's up), then retry navigating to the same impersonation URL or re-click Impersonate from the host admin tenants list if the token has since expired.

The impersonation token in the redirect URL is short-lived but survived at least a ~4 minute gap (server-down wait) in one observed run -- worth trying the same URL again before re-deriving a fresh token via the host admin flow.

usefulNavigationFromHere.hits: Pre Employment dashboard (#/app/pre-employment) has date-range display + charts, good general smoke check for date-formatting helpers (UtilsHelper) even though tenant's UtilsHelper.ts itself wasn't touched by task 5.1 (additive-only, no tenant call sites migrated yet)
